newsitem.title: USA: Alexander Haagen sells stock worth $19.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Alexander Haagen sells stock worth $19.6 mln.

text.p: Alexander Haagen Properties Inc said Thursday it had sold slightly over 1.3 million shares to an affiliate of Lazard Freres Real Estate Investors LLC, raising a total $19.6 million and boosting Lazard's stake in Alexander Haagen to 9.8 percent.
The purchase is the first phase of a previously announced $235 million strategic equity investment by Lazard Freres, Alexander Haagen said in a statement.
Alexander Haagen said it had set July 11 as the record date for a shareholder vote on the investment by Lazard Freres.
